t: 第一支由150名瑞士卫队组成的分遣队抵达梵蒂冈.
te: The first contingent of 150 Swiss Guards arrives at the Vatican.
dz: 第一支由150名瑞士卫队组成的分遣队抵达梵蒂冈.
de: The first contingent of 150 Swiss Guards arrives at the Vatican.

te: The cornerstone of the current St. Peter's Basilica is laid.

dz: 里斯本大屠杀开始,约两千名被强迫皈依基督教的犹太人被葡萄牙天主教徒屠戮.
de: The Lisbon Massacre begins, in which about two thousand Jews who had been forcibly converted to Christianity are slaughtered by Portuguese Catholics.

t: 三天的里斯本大屠杀随着葡萄牙天主教徒屠杀了1900多名疑似犹太人而结束.
te: The three-day Lisbon Massacre comes to an end with the slaughter of over 1,900 suspected Jews by Portuguese Catholics.
dz: 三天的里斯本大屠杀随着葡萄牙天主教徒屠杀了1900多名疑似犹太人而结束.

dz: 立陶宛大公国在克列茨克战役中击败克里米亚汗国.
